To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) MinHash clustering is a scalable and effective way of clustering users for collaborative filtering; (2) PLSI is a scalable way of generating personalized recommendations; (3) covisitation counts can be used to improve recommendations; and (4) a linear combination of recommendations from different algorithms improves the quality of recommendations.

1) collaborative filtering can be used to provide recommendations for news articles to a large audience, and 2) a combination of collaborative filtering techniques can be used to produce better recommendations than any individual approach.
